name: First User End-to-End Validation

blocking_defects.summary: Structured Analysis originally failed before the LLM call because a historical migration-version collision left action_plan_snapshots absent while version 008 was already recorded. Additive migration 014 repaired the missing table/index, readiness was hardened, and production service recovery passed.

After schema repair, Structured Analysis reached the configured Qwen provider but full non-streaming analysis timed out. Connection testing and a minimal JSON-mode request succeeded, while the real analysis request hit a 60-second ReadTimeout; increasing the configured timeout to 180 seconds still did not complete A06. The targeted production fix disables thinking only for qwen3.8 structured-analysis requests while preserving other model behavior and connection testing, and the first-user A06 rerun passed.

usability_findings.summary: Registration UI does not expose username/password validation rules and reduces structured HTTP 422 validation details to a generic HTTP 422 message.

notes: A01 account registration/session flow passed after using a username that conforms to the existing canonical server validation contract.
A02 passed after the user explicitly saved an OpenAI-compatible provider configuration and the connection test succeeded.
A03 passed: the first user successfully created and selected a Person, a Relationship scoped to that Person, and a Conversation scoped to that Person.
A04 passed: four real Message records were explicitly added to the selected Conversation and remained present after refresh.
A05 passed: the first user confirmed the selected Person Timeline rendered the expected real evidence without reporting cross-person contamination or duplicate-on-refresh behavior.
The first A06 attempt displayed Failed to fetch because the local SSH tunnel had terminated; that attempt was an environment interruption rather than a product failure.
After the tunnel was restored, A06 initially failed before the provider call because action_plan_snapshots was absent due to the historical migration-version collision.

Additive migration 014 repaired the missing action_plan_snapshots table and index while preserving the historical 008 ledger entry, and runtime readiness now detects missing migration-declared table/index objects.

During server-side validation, migration 014 was applied to the production database before the production checkout contained 014. Production was recovered by aligning code to CI-verified TEST-156 head 0bdcc6064cd7dc8be88670d4ba8b0ffe7aa0bc97; live/ready/preflight passed, migrations matched 001-014, and protected port 8899 remained PID 52822.

Pytest process-level isolation was added so test collection/execution defaults to a disposable temporary DATABASE_PATH before application imports. Safety CI run 35513527825 passed 16 focused, 170 auth, and 888 full-suite tests.
After schema recovery, A06 reached the LLM layer. The configured provider connection test succeeded and a minimal JSON-mode request completed successfully, proving connectivity and JSON mode support.

The real Structured Analysis HTTP request used a 3079-character serialized AnalysisContext and hit httpx.ReadTimeout at approximately 60.17 seconds. Retrying A06 after raising the configured timeout to 180 seconds still returned LLM analysis failed.
The targeted Qwen3.8 fix sends enable_thinking=false only for qwen3.8 structured-analysis requests. Existing non-Qwen3.8 request behavior and the connection-test contract remain unchanged.
Qwen3.8 fix CI run 35517192052 passed 54 focused provider/analysis tests, 170 auth regression tests, and 889 full-suite tests. Its temporary workflow was removed afterward.

The CI-verified Qwen3.8 fix was deployed to production at code head c305428906c2f6b894282810f64dacd961f23ac9. The service returned active with runtime PID 593044, a verified pre-deploy SQLite backup was created, and protected port 8899 remained PID 52822.
A06 passed after the production Qwen3.8 non-thinking fix. The first user received a complete StructuredAnalysis response and no cross-user or cross-conversation contamination was reported.

No username, password, API key, real name, relationship detail, private chat content, conversation identifier, evidence identifier, or model-generated private analysis text is recorded in this UAT artifact.
Real relationship and chat content remains in the production database and is not committed to GitHub.
Phase A now proceeds to A07 Strategy / Recommendation.
Phase B is longitudinal and should use genuine real-world events rather than synthetic completion.
